strings.name: Andrew Ng
strings.summary: Andrew Ng connects machine-learning research, practical engineering and online education. At Stanford he studied robotics and learning algorithms, helped establish Google Brain and later led AI research at Baidu. He co-founded Coursera with Daphne Koller and established education and venture projects including DeepLearning.AI. His influence spans research teams and wider access to AI training.
strings.coverageNote: Research checked through 13 November 2026; selected milestones extend to 2024. This is not a daily news archive. Shared achievements are credited to collaborators and teams.
strings.influence.rationale: Helped advance industrial applications of deep learning and online education, expanding AI courses, engineering practice and the entrepreneurship ecosystem.
strings.facts.fact-1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.fact-2.label: Education
strings.facts.fact-2.value: Carnegie Mellon bachelor's (1997); MIT master's (1998); UC Berkeley PhD (2002)
strings.highlights.highlight-1.title: Research and industry
strings.highlights.highlight-1.text: Helped establish Google Brain and advanced applied deep-learning research, including speech, at Baidu.
strings.highlights.highlight-2.title: Online learning
strings.highlights.highlight-2.text: Co-founded Coursera and broadened access to technical education through machine-learning courses and DeepLearning.AI.
strings.timeline.event-1.title: Joined Amazon's board
strings.timeline.event-1.text: Amazon announced his appointment to its board of directors.
strings.timeline.event-2.title: Established AI Fund
strings.timeline.event-2.text: Created a venture platform supporting the formation of AI companies.
strings.timeline.event-3.title: Baidu departure and new courses
strings.timeline.event-3.text: Announced his departure from Baidu and founded DeepLearning.AI that year.
strings.timeline.event-4.title: Became Baidu chief scientist
strings.timeline.event-4.text: Baidu appointed him chief scientist while opening a Silicon Valley research laboratory.
strings.timeline.event-5.title: Co-founded Coursera
strings.timeline.event-5.text: Founded the online education platform with Daphne Koller, bringing university courses to online learners.
strings.timeline.event-6.title: Google Brain and an online course
strings.timeline.event-6.text: Helped establish Google Brain and launched Stanford's widely attended online machine-learning course.
strings.timeline.event-7.title: PhD and Stanford faculty
strings.timeline.event-7.text: Earned a UC Berkeley computer-science doctorate and joined Stanford to study machine learning and robotics.
strings.timeline.event-8.title: Completed MIT master's
strings.timeline.event-8.text: Earned a master's in electrical engineering and computer science before doctoral study at Berkeley.
strings.timeline.event-9.title: Completed undergraduate study
strings.timeline.event-9.text: Graduated from Carnegie Mellon after studying computer science, statistics and economics.
strings.timeline.event-10.title: Born in London
strings.timeline.event-10.text: Born in London; later grew up in Hong Kong and Singapore before studying in the United States.
